description: Create a file named hello.py that prints 'Hello, World!' when run with python hello.py
In the file calculator.py, add a Python function named add(a, b) that returns the sum of two numbers. If the file does not exist, create it.

Create a file named broken.py with content: def greet(name)
    print(f'Hello {name}')  — then fix the syntax error so it runs without error.
Create a README.md file describing a Python project called MyApp that greets users. Include a one-line description, an Installation section with pip install instructions, and a Usage section.

Create fibonacci.py with a function fib(n) that returns the nth Fibonacci number (0-indexed, so fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1, fib(2)=1). Also add an if __name__ == '__main__' block that prints the first 10 Fibonacci numbers.
